prompt: Use case: style-transfer / logo-brand. Image 2 is the approved brand/logo style reference, especially the chunky golden crown, blue jewel, ivory battlements and dark espresso outlines. Image 3 is the binding illustrated village style reference, with warm ivory castle walls, rounded royal-blue roofs, simple broad 2-tone cel shading. Big simple shapes, soft irregular hand-drawn forms, thick dark espresso-brown outlines and restrained warm light edge shading, two broad color values only. Warm ivory stone, honey-gold crown, royal-blue roofs/jewel, plum background. One simple dark arched doorway. No windows smaller than a bold dot. No photorealism, no shiny 3D rendering, no bevelled metallic app tile. No rounded corners on the canvas: background extends opaque to all four edges. It should feel like a lovingly drawn castle from the supplied game, not a generic line icon.
